chapter_title_en: Second Floor: The Serpent Guard Puppet
chapter_seo_title: Void Heaven Palace Chapter 484: The Serpent Guard Puppet and the Indestructible Gem
chapter_meta_description: Han Li follows three Nascent Soul monsters into the Void Heaven Palace’s second floor, encounters the two-headed Serpent Guard Puppet, and witnesses a failed attempt to crush an ancient gem.
og_title: The Serpent Guard Puppet Meets Its Match
og_description: Man Brutal Beard’s Heavenly Devil Arts finally meet resistance—a four-armed snake puppet with indestructible cores.
twitter_title: Inside the Void Heaven Palace: Serpent Puppets and Indestructible Gems
twitter_description: Han Li continues his silent loot run as the Nascent Soul trio battles through the second floor of the Void Heaven Palace. A study in resource hoarding and power play.

lore_anchors.definition: A two-headed, four-armed snake-themed puppet guardian encountered on the second floor of the Void Heaven Palace inner hall; known for its speed, dual-element weapons, and indestructible core gem.
Man Brutal Beard’s signature body-cultivation technique; known for its terrifying defensive and offensive power against physical constructs, yet it fails to crush an ancient gem.

Green gems or stones left by ancient cultivators that cannot be destroyed, refined, or melted by modern means; their purpose is unknown and they are considered useless junk for most cultivators, but Han Li collects them on principle.
The supreme treasure sealed in the deepest chamber of the Void Heaven Palace; the primary objective of the demonic and righteous factions in the current expedition.
